# Command: create-build

Apply the `build-and-test` skill.

Check the dependencies and configuration. Configure the `build`, `test`, and `start` scripts in `package.json`. Add `tests/math.test.ts` with test cases for `BasicAddition`.

Run the build and tests if the environment allows it.

Do not claim success without actual execution results. If an error occurs, stop and explain the error.
